notes: A closer view: you and Biscuit are bigger on screen, the camera drifts toward where you point, and it pulls back to keep your cast in view.
A livelier lake: wind gusts sway the trees and ruffle across the water, and your angler hops when a fish bites and sighs when one gets away.
More variety: the same common fish turns up less often, fish you've never caught come along more, and small fish reel in quickly so the long fights are for the good ones.
The reel ring takes the fish's colours: blue, green, deep blue, violet or gold, with more sparkles the rarer it is.
The evening rise: at dusk the lake comes alive, bites come quicker and better fish are about. And on her first visit, Wren lends you her rowboat for the day.

Your dock fills up as you fish: a bait bucket, a tally board, a fish sign, rope and a net, flower pots and a wind chime. Fewer repeated pop-ups, controller buttons on the catch card, and a Radio volume slider in Audio settings.
